negative_sampling_fix.before: Excluded every movie ever rated by the user, including future interactions.
negative_sampling_fix.after: Excludes only movies rated up to the recommendation snapshot.

temporal_risk_policy: Stage-based global movie historical rating/count features are retained only for audit reference and are not eligible for final selection.

leakage_safe_full_content.description: Advanced features without stage-based movie historical rating/count.

leakage_safe_no_metadata_counts.description: Leakage-safe features without metadata entity-count proxies.

personalization_content_core.description: Strict personalization/content model: preference, affinities, genres, release/age/runtime, language, and franchise signal.

selection_rule: Highest validation NDCG@10 among leakage-safe variants only.
